subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw publish resetSessionEntryLifecycle as a shared Plugin SDK contract for plugins reacting to external lifecycle boundaries, including locked-harness owner handoff?
rationale: The patch is a plausible repair for the Teams bug, but a new public session-mutation API and its physical-owner release semantics become a compatibility commitment for all plugins rather than a purely local Teams change.

options.title: Accept the shared lifecycle API
options.body: Merge the scoped API and documentation as the supported generic way for an owning plugin to rotate a session after an externally observed lifecycle boundary.

options.title: Keep the reset seam owner-specific
options.body: Revise the patch so the Teams use case relies on a narrower internal or owner-plugin mechanism rather than expanding the public Plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared lifecycle API
recommendation.body: Merge the scoped API and documentation as the supported generic way for an owning plugin to rotate a session after an externally observed lifecycle boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR history shows direct involvement in narrowing the affected lifecycle behavior, and this decision concerns shared architecture and public Plugin SDK scope.
